title: Choose the visual world
question: Efficient and cool. The roll assigned The Field. The question, the answer, and the citation stay on one screen. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Field
options.lineage: one saturated field with the work cut out of it
options.thesis: The screen is a deep color. The work sits on one clear plate: ask, answer, citation. Nothing else competes.
options.viewport: Nav sits in the field: Ask, Documents, Tables, Graph, Admin. One bone plate holds the question, the source control, the answer, and Access policy, page 4. The citation is the only electric mark. A refusal stays on the plate, unlit, not deleted.
options.risk: Becomes a poster if the plate shrinks and the color starts doing the talking.

raised.raise: The live citation is the only thing that comes forward.
Color is the surround. The answer sits on a clear plate so it stays readable.
A refusal stays on the plate as an unlit row.
Opening a citation dims everything else. The passage is the high-contrast thing.
Refusal is the only second color. The answer stays in the primary ink.

options.label: The Night Desk
options.thesis: Navigation, the answer, and the open passage stay visible. The room is dark. One green mark shows what is live.
options.viewport: Left rail for Ask, Documents, Tables, Graph, Admin. Center: the question at the top, then the answer. Right: the passage. The citation link is the green mark.
options.risk: Also the dark dashboard most tools already ship.

options.label: The Tiles
options.thesis: The words are the interface. Question, answer, and citation are three tiles on the first screen.
options.viewport: Black ground. Three tiles, no scrolling: the question, the answer, and Access policy, page 4. Nav words sit on the top edge. The live tile is flooded cyan.
options.case: Bigger type and a more obvious first screen than the field. A tile can still feel like a phone home screen instead of a document.
options.risk: The passage becomes a tile and there is nowhere to read a long page.

options.label: The Box Wall
options.viewport: You pull a box to open the citation.
options.case: A stack is not this desk, and opening a lid is an extra step.
options.kept: The live item comes forward. The rest stays put.
options.risk: The answer is inside a box.

options.label: The Cloud Edge
options.lineage: a pastel fringe on a white cloud
options.viewport: Color sits in a fringe. The text stays gray on white.
options.case: Weather is not the task, and a fringe does not show a citation.
options.kept: Color stays at the edge. The reading surface stays clear.

options.label: The Segments
options.viewport: The answer is four digits on a black clock.
options.case: A sentence does not fit a digit mask.
options.kept: An absent state is drawn, not deleted.

options.label: The Bar Field
options.viewport: The screen strobes. Numbers pack the margin.
options.case: A barcode is not a paragraph, and strobe fights reading.
options.kept: Focus dims the rest of the field.

options.label: The Ready Room
options.viewport: The answer types itself one letter at a time.
options.case: Another terminal, and letter-by-letter print is slow.
options.kept: A refusal is a second ink. The answer stays in the first.
options.risk: Cool, and you wait for the sentence.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The chat used by ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, and Glean, played straight.
canonCard.viewport: Ask is a thread. You type at the bottom. Citations open in a drawer.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from those products, by design.
